Title: IStore<T> - Persistence Contract
Summary: Generic repository interface for entity persistence. Supports CRUD operations, querying with specifications, ordering, and paging. Implemented by FileStore for JSON file-based storage.
Content:
## IStore<T> - Persistence Contract

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Persistence.Contracts`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Persistence.Core`
**Version**: 0.6.0

### Purpose
Generic repository interface for entity persistence. All entities must implement `IEntity` (from `Cyrena.Core`).

### Type Constraint
```csharp
where T : class, IEntity
```

### Class Definition
```csharp
public interface IStore<T> : IDisposable
    where T : class, IEntity
{
    IQueryable<T> QueryableData { get; }
    Task SaveAsync(T entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task AddAsync(T entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task AddManyAsync(IEnumerable<T> entities, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task UpdateAsync(T entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task DeleteAsync(T entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task<int> DeleteManyAsync(ISpecification<T> specification, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task<IEnumerable<T>> FindManyAsync(ISpecification<T> specification, IOrderBy<T>? orderBy = default, IPaging? paging = default, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task<int> CountAsync(ISpecification<T> specification, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    Task<T?> FindAsync(ISpecification<T> specification, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}
```

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `QueryableData` | `IQueryable<T>` | Queryable access to all data |

### Methods

#### `SaveAsync(T entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Saves an entity. Creates if new, updates if existing (upsert).

#### `AddAsync(T entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Adds a new entity. Auto-generates ID if null.

#### `AddManyAsync(IEnumerable<T> entities, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Adds multiple entities.

#### `UpdateAsync(T entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Updates an existing entity.

#### `DeleteAsync(T entity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Deletes an entity.

#### `DeleteManyAsync(ISpecification<T> specification, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Deletes entities matching a specification. Returns count deleted.

#### `FindManyAsync(ISpecification<T> specification, IOrderBy<T>? orderBy = default, IPaging? paging = default, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Finds entities matching a specification with optional ordering and paging.

#### `CountAsync(ISpecification<T> specification, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Counts entities matching a specification.

#### `FindAsync(ISpecification<T> specification, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Finds a single entity matching a specification.

### Extension Methods (StoreExtensions, in `Cyrena.Extensions`)
- `FindAsync(Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate, CancellationToken ct = default)` - Find by lambda
- `FindManyAsync(Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate, OrderBy<T>? orderBy = null, Paging? paging = null, CancellationToken ct = default)` - Find many by lambda
- `CountAsync(Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate, CancellationToken ct = default)` - Count by lambda
- `DeleteManyAsync(Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate, CancellationToken ct = default)` - Delete by lambda

### Registration
```csharp
// In CyrenaBuilder configuration
builder.AddSingletonStore<MyEntity>("my_collection");
builder.AddScopedStore<MyEntity>("my_collection");
```
